name: compliance-rules-engine-monorepo
description: Monorepo: the compliance-rules-engine library (packages/core) and its Next.js playground (apps/web).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w compliance-rules-engine && npm run dev -w @cre/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.site: npm run build && npm run build:web
